en: Sanborn Fire Insurance Map, Norwood Park (West Long Branch), Monmouth County, New Jersey, 1907, New Jersey Coast Volume 1, Sheet 5

sheet-9999997.description: Norwood Park, a summer-estate district inland from the Long Branch shore, as drawn in 1907 on sheet 5 of the Sanborn New Jersey Coast volume 1, at 120 feet to an inch. The area lies in what is now West Long Branch. Hollywood Avenue crosses the upper part of the sheet and Cedar Avenue runs diagonally across the lower half; Milleman, Brook-Willow Avenue and Norwood Avenue run up and down the sheet, with Park View Avenue between Brook-Willow and Norwood, and a private drive along the top edge. The blocks along Hollywood Avenue and Brook-Willow Avenue hold rows of numbered frame cottages of two and a half storeys, and a casino stands in the block between Hollywood and Park View Avenues; a large block west of Brook-Willow Avenue is marked as a playground for children. South of Park View Avenue, on Norwood Avenue, is the brick mansion of M. Guggenheim with its curved wings. South of Cedar Avenue is White Park, the estate of A. White, with a large frame house, a tank in a tower, stables or outbuildings, a hen house and a note on its fire hose and chemical engine. Farm barns with a wind mill and water tank stand at the lower left. Norwood Avenue is drawn in two pieces offset at Cedar Avenue, and Kirby Avenue is lettered at the bottom edge. The margins carry the numbers of adjoining sheets (9 and 10) and blank areas marked 0. The street at the left edge is not lettered.
notes: Printed sheet 5 of New Jersey Coast volume 1; the place is in West Long Branch, Monmouth County, not Norwood in Bergen County. The reference data was refetched for a box around West Long Branch.
Milleman is Pinewood Avenue today; Park View Avenue is Beechwood Avenue; Brook-Willow Avenue is Brookwillow Avenue; the unlettered street at the left edge is Elmwood Avenue.
The M. Guggenheim house is today the Guggenheim Library of Monmouth University.
Cedar Avenue / Pinewood Avenue and the Beechwood junctions west of Brookwillow were not detected.
Detected with ink_below_paper 80; scale 120 ft to an inch (fitted 3.22 px/ft).
